stem.text: A longitudinal wave is travelling from left to right. The graph shows the variation of the displacement of the particles with distance along the wave at one instant in time.
Displacements to the right are positive; displacements to the left are negative.
Which labelled point represents a compression?

stem.alt: Graph of displacement against distance along a longitudinal wave at one instant, a sinusoidal curve with the horizontal axis labelled distance and the vertical axis labelled displacement, with 0 marked on the vertical axis. Points labelled A, B, C and D are marked on the curve.
